free_text: A repeat biopsy is recommended because the serial PSA trend is rising, with the last value at 9.5 ng/mL, and the mpMRI shows a PI-RADS 3 lesion. Although the prior biopsy confirmed ISUP GG 2 disease, the rising PSA velocity of 1.85 ng/mL/yr suggests disease progression that warrants further histological confirmation. The decision was reached as the evidence converged despite the missing surveillance details.
